name: Guru Randhawa
description: '''Gursharanjot Singh "Guru" Randhawa''' (born 30 August 1991) is an [[India|Indian]] singer, songwriter and music composer associated with [[Music of Punjab|Punjabi]], [[Bhangra (music)|bhangra]], [[indi-pop]] and [[Bollywood music]]. Guru Randhawa's debut song was "Same Girl" in collaboration with [[Arjun (singer)|Arjun]]. He is known for his songs "[[Lahore (song)|Lahore]]", "[[Ishare Tere]]", "[[Slowly Slowly (Guru Randhawa song)|Slowly Slowly]]", and "[[Tere Te]]".
